name: Northeast Indiana Innovation Community (NIIC)
reason: Fort Wayne's innovation centre and coworking space at 3211 Stellhorn Rd. It ran in-person Vibe Code Hack Nights on 2026-08-20 and 2026-10-29, and has a Founders Tech Club (Dec 2) and a Holiday Hacker Happy Hour (Dec 9) upcoming. It also lists many general small-business workshops (Discovery Workshop, marketing plan, women's circle), which the relevance gate should drop. Not in the registry.

name: AI in Fort Wayne (Angie Carel)
reason: Organiser of the free monthly 'AI in Fort Wayne | Monthly Community Meetup' (Corporate Engagement Center, Keene Building, Indiana Tech, per TechPoint's calendar). It also runs Makers Nights and Hops and Bots happy hours. Upcoming: 2026-12-10 and 2027-01-08 (Eventbrite collection 'Fort Wayne AI Community'). Some sessions also have a virtual option. Not in the registry.

name: OneSixOne Ventures (luma.com/onesixonevc)
reason: Pre-seed VC whose public Luma calendar carries in-person tech and startup events: Gainesville Startup Hour (Sep 2025, Jan 2026), Florida Tech Summit (2026-03-26, Emerson Alumni Hall, UF), Florida Startup Summit (Oct), and Enterprise AI and Cybersecurity summits in NYC, Seattle, Atlanta and DC. Not in the registry.
